files.rationale: Kept PR A's rename to the OMP variant and its split of the q6_K GEMM quantize/dot loops, while applying PR B's ggml_interface.cpp optimizations (active bspool handle, BS thread-pool GEMM loop replacing the omp pragma/todo, SIMD q8_K quantization in the split loop) consistent with B's already-merged BS/pooled-buffer code, and added the bs_thread_pool_manager.hpp include that ThreadPoolManager requires.
